name: assayer
description: Evidence-backed audits and deterministic plugin development in Codex

interface.shortDescription: Audit interfaces, run plugins, and verify plugin source projects.
interface.longDescription: Assayer guides Codex through bounded, evidence-backed audits, installed-plugin lifecycles, and deterministic local plugin verification. It compiles supported authoring formats, validates one exact wheel, and returns traceable findings or release artifacts from natural-language requests.
defaultPrompt: Audit this web URL for frontend issues: <URL>
Run the installed plugin for this input and produce an evidence-backed report.
Verify this local Assayer plugin source and build its exact release wheel.
Continue the Assayer audit and explain the current progress.
Explain the Assayer result and what I should do next.
